scope: Complete author reading of all four middleware pages and inspection of their exact-example tests. Not RLS, background-worker identity, production proxy or durable-log certification.

reviews.reason: Explains constructor versus add_middleware ordering, exact timing scope and request-context lifetime without implying permission enforcement.
Provides an explicit JSON formatter, current defaults, log levels and context ordering; excludes body collection and automatic redaction/audit guarantees.
Documents unvalidated client values, UUID fallback, response-header timing and finally reset; correlation is not identity or idempotency.
Labels header/subdomain extraction as untrusted, lists exact options and rejection rules, and links verified membership/RLS instead of assuming isolation.
